responsibilities: tracking session issue, expiry, and revocation
systemOfRecord.ai: FastAPI recommendations are reached through Spring Boot. The citizen website does not call FastAPI and does not diagnose.

time: UTC ISO-8601 in the API; local time only in the browser

modes.development: In-memory synthetic missions only. Every tracking payload has synthetic=true. Demo routes are enabled. This is not a mission database.
modes.proxy: Forwards /api/v1/citizen to AEGIS_BACKEND_BASE_URL. Demo routes return DEMO_DISABLED. If the backend is unreachable the adapter returns UNAVAILABLE and does not invent a mission.
